scientific_sources.policy: Use the three hash-pinned primary sources and their qualified equivalence checks. Do not redistribute their PDFs.

publication_guidance.title: Submit TeX/LaTeX
publication_guidance.qualified_use: Requires complete TeX inputs, included bibliography files, standard supported packages, and author inspection of the generated PDF.

publication_guidance.title: Referencing and citing content
publication_guidance.qualified_use: Documents release-based Zenodo archiving, DOI issuance, and the need for a repository license.

publication_guidance.title: Enable a repository
publication_guidance.qualified_use: Documents GitHub repository connection and automatic ingestion of new releases.

publication_guidance.title: Version control, corrections, and retractions
publication_guidance.qualified_use: Supports explicit distinction among draft, preprint, accepted manuscript, version of record, and corrected versions.

guidance_boundary: Publication guidance controls packaging metadata only and supplies no mathematical evidence.
